ITA-1.9.4.3.4 duḥkham दुःखम्
Sorrow, pain
An unfavourable perception including unhappiness, sorrow and grief; the opposite of pleasure.

ITA-5.64.25 duḥkhavardhanaḥ दुःखवर्धनः
Traumatic lobulitis due to improper ear piercing
A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: a swelling of the ear lobe with itching; swelling of ear lobe with burning sensation; swelling of ear lobe associated with pain; swelling of ear lobe with suppurating tendency.

duḥkhāyuḥ दुःखायुः
Poor quality of life
A lifestyle characterized by a low quotient of happiness.
